//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Fish On The Line -> Config

Enable Fish On The Line.//: Whether Fish On The Line is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart. Do not disable a mod that adds blocks or items to an existing world, they will be removed.

mustHoldBellInOffhand.//: If enabled, the fish on the line sound will only go off if a bell is held in the offhand while fishing.
